limitations: Only ordinary Hom(C_n, KG(5,2)) for n>=3. Not a homeomorphism, equivariant classification, all square-free-target formula, or independent certification. Priority risk: a generic reconfiguration algorithm may have unstated or unpublished enumerative specialization.
scientific_integrity: The result is a uniform enumeration of all source lengths. The component homotopy-type trichotomy and universal-cover contraction are published input theorems, not claimed as discoveries. Integer checks through length twelve corroborate but do not prove the infinite statement.
title: A primitive-period formula for all Petersen cycle-Hom complexes
